name: National Fittings Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, National Fittings Ltd manufactures spheroidal graphite pipe fittings, stainless steel fittings and stainless steel ball valves
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is an export oriented ISO 9001 certified manufacturer of quality Piping components and Pumps for industrial and non-industrial applications. It operates multiple foundries including an investment casting foundry utilizing lost wax process and an exclusive supply source for its entire casting requirements. Company exports these products mainly to Middle East and also to United States of America, Europe, South America and Australia

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 36.7% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 19.4%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.57% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.28% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.16.2 Cr.
